# Fixed v5 development submission

This package exercises both WitnessBench certificate checks, PoW binding, PR
archiving, and publication without a solver or network access. Its epoch uses the
small development profile and its observation time is fixed in experiment.json.
Never add this epoch or package to the production registry or public paper archive.

The only supplied witnesses are the certificates inside the normal submission
package. No solution walkthrough, answer service, or reusable solver is included.
